settings.title: How to use it?
settings.content:
• Prep — Cleanse the client, dry skin. Lightly mist the face with RePlenish Spritzer or apply a water-based prep serum.
  • Gel Application — Apply a generous, even layer of ReStore or ReNu conductive gel to the treatment area using the silicone brush or applicator. For ATP mask sessions apply gel where indicated.
  • Mask / Probe Setup
     • For ATP mask protocol: place the ATP masks (eye/forehead/lip/forehead as required) and connect lead wires. Confirm mask contact and comfort.
    • For probe/glove work: attach probes or conductive gloves and position per zone.
  • Device Programming — Use the MyoLift 600+ settings appropriate for the protocol: typically a lymphatic/erase pass followed by educate/program for muscle re-education and ATP stimulation. Follow established clinic timings.
  • During Treatment — Monitor client comfort and conductivity. If mask slip occurs, reapply small amount of gel or use RePlenish mist. For ATP sessions adhere to recommended ATP mask timing.
  • Finish — Remove masks or probes, lightly massage remaining gel into skin or remove as indicated. Complete with post-treatment serums or moisturizers from your Classic backbar. Clean and disinfect probes, gloves, and reusable tools. Restock single-use ATP masks and small consumables as needed.

settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.title1: Who is this professional bundle designed for?
settings.text1: Licensed estheticians, med-spas, and high-volume clinics needing up to 120 microcurrent treatments with reliable performance.
settings.title2: What makes this kit different from standard backbar sets?
settings.text2: It combines ATP mask treatments with the Classic backbar, including full-size gels, gloves, applicators, and Gua Sha tools, all in one bundle.
settings.title3: How do I set up the device for ATP mask treatments?
settings.text3: Apply the appropriate gel, place the ATP masks, connect the lead wires, and use the 600+ settings for lymphatic/erase passes followed by Educate/ATP stimulation.
settings.title4: Can this kit be used for both ATP masks and probe/glove work?
settings.text4: Yes. The bundle supports mask protocols, probes, and conductive gloves for full-face or targeted treatments.
settings.title5: How do I maintain the kit for professional use?
settings.text5: Clean and disinfect probes and gloves after each session, restock single-use ATP masks, and store gels properly to ensure consistent conductivity.
settings.title6: How long will this kit last in a busy spa?
settings.text6: The included consumables and gels are designed for up to 120 treatments, making it ideal for clinics with high client volume.
